what: a 20 x 20 square swept 250 mm along the axis of a tube (ID 20, OD 30, 250 long) with a 30 degree twist, cut from it (the twisted cut froze the app)
method: the square (inscribed circle r 10 = the bore, half diagonal 14.14 < 15) turns about the tube axis, so at every height the cut section is the same: the part of the annulus inside the square = square - bore disc. What is left is the OD disc minus the square: area pi 225 - 400 = 306.86, a connected ring, V = 250 (225 pi - 400) = 76714.6.
